title: %upper — uppercase a string
purpose: Uppercase every character of a string value.
notes: First and only argument is the string to uppercase.
The argument must be a reference (@.name) or a quoted literal — a bare word is read as a literal string, not a path.

avoid.why: missing the source argument — the engine raises a verb-arity error
bare word name is read as the literal string "name", producing "NAME"; use @.name to read the field
